english.title: Supervisor of provisional licence holder fail to give own name and address - road
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the person supervising **(..SPECIFY NAME..), the holder of a provisional licence, while

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

was driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD OR PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a constable, failed to give your name and address
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(6) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

(i) The above does not apply to invalid carriages.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.

english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, was supervising **(..SPECIFY DRIVER..), the holder of a provisional licence, who was driving **(..SPECIFY ROAD OR PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to give his name and address to a police constable when requested to do so.
